description: Replace CaseStudyCard with flat-prop API, create ProjectsClient ('use client') with URL-synced filtering, create projects/page.tsx RSC with Payload data fetching, and create projects/[slug]/page.tsx RSC detail page. These four files are tightly coupled by the normalizeCaseStudy data shape and must be built together.
steps: Step 1: Replace src/components/cards/CaseStudyCard.tsx entirely. Remove the nested caseStudy prop and the extractPlainText helper. New props interface (flat): { slug: string; projectTitle: string; authorizedClientName?: string; sectorName?: string; challengeExcerpt?: string; metrics?: Array<{ metric: string; value: string; context?: string }> }. No 'use client' directive. Design: group-hover gold top bar (h-1 bg-transparent group-hover:bg-gold), teal sector badge (bg-teal/10 text-teal text-xs), font-playfair h3 text-navy, authorizedClientName in text-slate-600 text-sm, challengeExcerpt line-clamp-2 text-sm text-slate-600, metrics flex gap-4 with font-playfair gold value + xs label, View Case Study -> Link to /projects/${slug}.

Step 2: Create src/app/projects/ProjectsClient.tsx. Mark 'use client' at top. Define plain interfaces: FilterOption { id: string; label: string }, CaseStudyItem { slug, projectTitle, authorizedClientName?, sectorName?, sectorId?, challengeExcerpt?, metrics?, relatedServiceIds?: string[] }, ProjectsClientProps { caseStudies: CaseStudyItem[], industries: FilterOption[], services: FilterOption[] }. Use useSearchParams + useRouter from 'next/navigation'. On mount read ?sector= and ?service= params. On select change call router.push with updated URLSearchParams. Filter logic via useMemo: filter caseStudies where (sectorId matches or no sector filter) AND (relatedServiceIds.includes(serviceId) or no service filter). Sticky filter bar: sticky top-[72px] z-30 bg-white border-b border-[#E2E8F0] py-4 shadow-card-1 — two <select> elements (default option 'All Sectors' / 'All Services'), active filter count badge (inline-flex items-center justify-center w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-gold text-white text-xs, only shown when count > 0), 'Clear Filters' button when any filter active, '{n} project(s) found' result count. Grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 py-12. Render <CaseStudyCard> per filtered item passing flat props. Empty state: centered div with 'No projects match your filters.' text and 'Clear Filters' button.

Step 3: Create src/app/projects/page.tsx. Export metadata { title: 'Projects & Portfolio | Pulse Consultant Ltd', description: 'Explore our case studies...' }. Define extractPlainText(val: unknown): string — walk Payload Lexical JSON (val.root.children[].children[].text), join texts, truncate to 150 chars, return '' for non-objects or errors. Define NormalizedCaseStudy interface (matches CaseStudyItem + relatedServiceIds). Define normalizeCaseStudy(doc: Record<string, unknown>): NormalizedCaseStudy — cast fields: projectTitle as string, slug as string, authorizedClientName as string | undefined, check typeof doc.sector === 'object' to get sectorName (sector.name) and sectorId (sector.id as string), extract challengeExcerpt via extractPlainText(engagement?.businessChallenge), map results?.metrics?.slice(0,3), map relatedService array via Array.isArray check to relatedServiceIds. In async default export: try { payload = await getPayloadClient(); fetch case-studies (isApprovedForPublic: { equals: true }, status: { equals: 'published' }, depth: 2, limit: 100), industries (status: { equals: 'published' }, limit: 50), services (status: { equals: 'published' }, limit: 50) } catch { all three = [] }. Map to plain objects. Render: (1) navy hero section-container py-20 with breadcrumb nav 'Home / Projects', font-playfair h1 'Projects & Portfolio', subtitle 'Discover how we have helped clients achieve measurable results.'; (2) <Suspense fallback={...}><ProjectsClient .../></Suspense>.

Step 4: Create src/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx. Interface Props { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }. Export generateStaticParams: try { payload.find case-studies isApprovedForPublic:true limit:100 } catch { return [] }; return docs.map(c => ({ slug: c.slug as string })). Export generateMetadata({ params }): await params, try fetch by slug, return { title: seo.metaTitle || projectTitle + ' | Pulse Consultant Ltd', description: seo.metaDescription || '' } catch { return {} }. Define renderField(val: unknown): string { return typeof val === 'string' ? val : '[Content available in CMS]' }. In default async export: const { slug } = await params; try { payload.find case-studies where slug:equals AND isApprovedForPublic:equals:true depth:2 limit:1 } catch { notFound() }; if (!docs[0]) notFound(). Cast doc = docs[0] as Record<string, unknown>. Access nested fields: engagement = doc.engagement as Record<string,unknown>, results = doc.results as Record<string,unknown>. Build 8 sections: (1) Hero bg-navy text-white py-20 section-container: breadcrumb 'Home / Projects / {title}', sector badge (teal, extract from populated sector.name), font-playfair text-4xl md:text-5xl h1 projectTitle, authorizedClientName subtitle. (2) Challenge + Scope bg-offwhite py-16 section-container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 — left 'Business Challenge' heading + renderField(engagement.businessChallenge); right 'Assignment Scope' + renderField(engagement.assignmentScope). (3) Consulting Approach bg-white py-16 section-container: border-l-4 border-gold pl-6 — 'Our Approach' heading + renderField(engagement.consultingApproach). (4) Deliverables bg-navy text-white py-16 section-container: 'What We Delivered' font-playfair h2 + ul list of deliverables[].deliverable with gold bullet (before:content-['›'] or inline span). (5) Verified Results bg-offwhite py-16 section-container: 'Verified Results' heading + metrics grid (1/2/3 cols, each card bg-white border-t-4 border-gold rounded p-6: font-playfair text-3xl gold value, metric label, context in text-slate-500 text-sm) + renderField(results.summary) below. (6) Testimonial conditional bg-white py-16 section-container: only if results.clientTestimonial — blockquote with text-gold text-5xl leading quote mark, italic testimonial text, '— {testimonialAuthor}'. (7) Related Services bg-teal text-white py-16 section-container: 'Related Services' heading + flex-wrap gap-4 of service pill links (bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm Link to /services/{slug}). Only render if relatedService array non-empty. (8) CTA bg-navy text-white py-16 section-container text-center: font-playfair h2 'Ready to Start Your Project?' + subtitle + <Button variant='outline' href='/#contact'>Schedule a Consultation</Button>.
acceptance_criteria: CaseStudyCard accepts flat props (slug, projectTitle, authorizedClientName?, sectorName?, challengeExcerpt?, metrics?) and renders without errors
ProjectsClient correctly reads ?sector and ?service URL params and updates them on dropdown change
ProjectsClient filter bar is sticky at top-[72px] z-30
projects/page.tsx wraps all Payload calls in try/catch
projects/[slug]/page.tsx uses params: Promise<{slug: string}> with await
projects/[slug]/page.tsx calls notFound() for missing or non-approved slugs
renderField returns '[Content available in CMS]' for richText objects
No @/payload-types import in any client component
npm run build completes with exit code 0 and no TypeScript errors
verification: Run `npm run build` from d:\Downloads\Pulse-Consultant — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors
Run `npm run dev` and visit http://localhost:3000/projects — page loads, filter bar is sticky, dropdowns work
Visit http://localhost:3000/projects/[any-slug] with an approved case study — all 8 sections render
findings: Build passes (exit 0, TypeScript OK). Postgres auth errors during generateStaticParams are expected in this environment (no local DB running) — all try/catch blocks return [] correctly. Routes /projects (Static) and /projects/[slug] (SSG) appear in the Next.js build output. The CaseStudyCard flat-prop API is in place; no other files reference the old nested-prop API. industries filter uses industry.id (string cast from number), services filter uses service.id similarly — this is consistent with how other collection pages work in the project.
